title: Umurinzi w'Irembo ry'Izuba Riva
intro: Muri Korowani yose, hari abantu bamwe bazenguruka isi basiga inzira z'ubwenge n'ibitangaza. Umwe muri abo bantu yagiye kure cyane y'irema—aho izuba rirasira rigaca rirenga, aho uruzitiro rubuza akajagari ubwarwo. Uyu mugaragu wa Allah yahawe ubwami butazongera kuboneka ukundi. Mu ngendo eshatu zitandukanye, intego y'uyu muntu yarasobanuwe neza. Ese ushobora kumenya uyu muzererezi w'inkuru mu bicucu by'amateka?
clues: Nahawe ububasha n'Imbabazi nyinshi bwo gutegeka isi mu buryo butigeze bugerwaho n'undi muntu uwo ari we wese.
Nagiye mu burengerazuba kugeza aho izuba rirenga, nsanga rirenze mu isoko ryijimye, maze mbona abantu baho.
Nagiye iburasirazuba kugeza ubwo nageze aho izuba rirasira, nsanga rirasira ku bantu tutabashyiriyeho ubuhungiro.
Nanyuze hagati y’izo ngingo ebyiri zikomeye kugeza ubwo nageze mu kibaya kiri hagati y’imisozi ibiri, aho nasanze abantu batashoboraga kumva neza imvugo.
Nabonye ku musozi inzitizi ebyiri zikomeye z'icyuma zigera iburyo n'ibumoso, hagati yazo hari inzira nto. Aba bantu bansabye guca ku ruzitiro rubuza akajagari.

Nafashe ibyo nabaga mfite maze ndavuga nti: 'Uruzitiro niruzameneka, ibi bizaba ari itandukaniro rigaragara hagati yacu n'aba bantu.' Igihe cyagenwe kigeze, narebye ukuntu urwo ruzitiro rwasenyutse burundu.

trial.label: Igeragezwa/Ikibazo
options: Guca uruzitiro rw'icyuma ku baturage ba Yajuj na Majuj
Kwambuka inyanja itukura hamwe n'abantu bizera
Kubaka urugomero rwo kurinda igihugu gikiranuka
trial.answer: Guca uruzitiro rw'icyuma ku baturage ba Yajuj na Majuj

location.label: Ikintu cy'ingenzi
options: Inzu yera yo gusengeramo i Yerusalemu
Uruzi rwo mu gihugu cya Egiputa

outcome.label: Ibisubizo
options: Uruzitiro rwaciwe igihe cyagenwe kigeze, maze havuka akaduruvayo
Abatizera barohamye mu gihe abizera bakizwaga
Abakiranutsi bayobowe muri paradizo y'iteka ryose
Umujyi warasenyutse kubera umuyaga uhuha cyane
outcome.answer: Uruzitiro rwaciwe igihe cyagenwe kigeze, maze havuka akaduruvayo

arabic: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰذَا ٱلْقَرْنَيْنِ إِنَّ يَأْجُوجَ وَمَأْجُوجَ مُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَهَلْ نَجْعَلُ لَكَ خَرْجًا عَلَىٰٓ أَن تَجْعَلَ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَهُمْ سَدًّۭا
verse: They said, "O Dhul-Qarnayn, indeed Gog and Magog are [great] corrupters in the land. So may we assign for you an expenditure that you might make between us and them a barrier?" (18:94)
